brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's security cabinet ordered the military to step up preparations for a possible attack on Iran, Middle East Eye reported. The directive came during a cabinet meeting on Wednesday as tensions between Israel and Iran remain elevated.

Details of the operational readiness plan were not disclosed. The order reflects ongoing concerns over Iranian regional activities and potential threats to Israeli security.
dek: Netanyahu orders Israeli army to prepare for possible attack on Iran Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's security cabinet ordered the military to step up preparations for a possible attack on Iran, Israeli media reported on Wednesday.
title: Netanyahu orders military to prepare for Iran attack
